The video has been rendered successfully. Here's what was created:

**Output:** `video/out/explainer.mp4` (2 MB, 15 seconds, 1920x1080, 30fps)

**The video has 6 scenes:**

| Scene | Duration | Content |
|-------|----------|---------|
| **Title** | 2.5s | "External Agents" with gradient text and tagline |
| **The Problem** | 3s | Three warning cards: no audit trail, self-reported tests, no rewind |
| **The Solution** | 3s | Shows all supported agents (Claude Code, Kiro, Grok, Qwen, Goose, GitHub Actions) funneling into the Entire CLI protocol |
| **How It Works** | 3s | 5-step animated flow: Hook In -> Capture Evidence -> Build Change Passport -> ProofGate Evaluates -> Decision |
| **ProofGate** | 2s | Shield icon with key features: immutable evidence, deterministic policy, privacy-first |
| **Closing** | 1.5s | "Ship AI Code with Confidence" call-to-action |

All scenes use spring animations, gradient colors, and a dark theme. You can preview it with `npx remotion preview src/index.ts` from the `video/` directory if you want to tweak anything before sharing.
